meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: Claude 会在每次回复前自动调取相关历史记忆,每轮结束后把新见解写入持久记忆。记忆存放在每个 agent group 挂载的 .claude/ 目录里,容器重启后仍然保留。
howto.when: 在运行默认 Claude provider 的 agent group 上生效(container.json 中 provider 为 claude 或未设置);每组容器启动时运行 mnemon setup 注册 hooks。

say.text: 给这个 agent group 装上 mnemon 持久记忆。
检查一下 mnemon 的 hooks 注册成功了没。
say.note: 会查看容器日志和 settings.json。

say.text: 把某个 agent 的记忆全部清空。
say.note: 停容器后删除宿主机上的 mnemon/ 目录。

howto.what_en: Claude recalls relevant past memory before each reply and stores new insights after every turn. Memory lives in the group's mounted .claude/ directory and survives container restarts.
howto.when_en: Applies to agent groups using the default Claude provider (provider absent or "claude" in container.json); mnemon setup registers hooks when each container starts.

say_en.text: Install mnemon persistent memory for this agent group.
say_en.note: Edits Dockerfile and entrypoint, then rebuilds the image.

say_en.text: Check whether the mnemon hooks are registered.
say_en.note: Looks at container logs and settings.json.

say_en.text: Clear all memory for one agent.
say_en.note: Stops the container and deletes the mnemon/ dir on the host.
